fact: Iwacu reports the director of Land Titles and the National Cadastre announced on 17 March 2026 the secured electronic land title, with title files received at centres in Bujumbura, Gitega, Makamba and Ngozi by 30 April 2026.

We Are Tech Africa reports the land directorate DTFCN runs a Building Permit System for initial titles and a Property Management System for transfers, corrections and mortgages, joined by an EDRMS launched 17 June 2025.
source_slug: 2025-06-18 Burundi's Land Services Go Digital with New Integrated Platform

fact: ABP reports the Prime Minister launched on 14 July 2026 the RPPCUB-2026 urban owner census to build a digitised, geo-referenced land register, starting in Muha, Mukaza, Ntahangwa, Gitega, Ngozi and Rumonge.
The Ministry of Finance posted joint ordinance 550/540/998 of 6 February 2026 setting the terms for acquiring the secured electronic land title.

On 2026-07-14 the Prime Minister of Burundi launched the RPPCUB 2026 census of urban property owners, whose stated aim is a fully digitised, geo-referenced land register, starting in Mugere, Mukaza, Ntahangwa, Gitega, Ngozi and Rumonge communes before national roll-out, with enumerators from INSBU working with the land-titles and cadastre directorate (DTFCN).

The article says the DTFCN uses a Property Management System that handles updates to existing titles (transfers, corrections, mortgages) and a Building Permit System that handles issuing first titles, both interconnected with the new EDRMS.
